settings.security.enforcement.title: Session Enforcement Policy
settings.security.enforcement.descriptio:
Controls how aggressively JWT tokens are tied to an active session record.

Strict mode rejects any token without a matching session. This is more secure, but tokens issued before this plugin was installed will also be rejected.
settings.security.enforcement.strict.des:
Reject every authenticated request that does not have a matching session record.

Recommended for production.
settings.security.enforcement.maxAge.hin: Sessions older than {days} days are automatically terminated, even if they are still active.
settings.security.enforcement.trustedPro:
Only enable this when Strapi runs behind a trusted reverse proxy such as nginx or Cloudflare.

Otherwise, clients can spoof the X-Forwarded-For header.
settings.security.enforcement.warning.bo:
Tokens without a matching session record are allowed through.

Manual session termination is still enforced via the token hash. We strongly recommend enabling strict mode in production.
settings.security.encryption.title: JWT Encryption Key Generator
settings.security.encryption.description: Generate a random 256-bit key (64 hexadecimal characters). The server uses it to encrypt tokens before storing them in the database.
settings.security.encryption.envHint: Add this key to your .env file as SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY for production.
